_comment: Curated descriptive metadata for the CB service catalog, pulled from the cb-catalog MCP server. The AUTHORITATIVE list of what exists and how many endpoints each has comes from the unified OpenAPI spec at generation time; this file only supplies human-readable metadata. A service in the spec but missing here is reported as uncatalogued rather than dropped.

services.name: AI API
services.description: Unified AI provider: Claude, Ollama, Mistral. Chat completions, embeddings, OCR, summarization, topic extraction, usage tracking. Embedded MCP at /mcp.

services.name: Intelligence API
services.description: Web crawling, screenshots, transcripts, document processing, workspaces. Scheduler for recurring jobs, planner for multi-step research. Embedded MCP at /mcp.

services.name: Agent Memory
services.description: Hierarchical memory for AI agents. Three layers: Resources (raw), Items (facts), Categories (summaries). Temporal awareness with decay. Embedded MCP at /mcp.

services.name: Document Index
services.description: Vectorless RAG document indexing using PageIndex. PDF/markdown indexing, OCR, YouTube transcripts, workspace-scoped conversations. Embedded MCP at /mcp.

services.name: Document Partitioning
services.description: Document parsing and element extraction via Unstructured library. PDF, DOCX, images, email, markdown. Embedded MCP at /mcp.

services.name: Generative AI Proxy
services.description: Thin FastAPI proxy for ComfyUI generative AI backend. Health checks, GPU status, sprite generation, output management.

services.name: Text-to-Speech
services.description: Real-time neural text-to-speech powered by VibeVoice. Multiple voice presets, streaming PCM16, complete WAV generation.

services.name: Contact Data ETL
services.description: Contact data processing ETL. Address normalization and parsing via libpostal, batch processing, deduplication hashes. Embedded MCP at /mcp.

services.name: Congressional Districts
services.description: 119th Congress, 441 districts. Demographics, GeoJSON boundaries, radio coverage, geographic layers, state data. Embedded MCP at /mcp.

services.name: Voter Analysis
services.description: AI-powered voter segment analysis, behavioral enrichment, campaign data, voter search, and address hygiene. Embedded MCP at /mcp.

services.name: Survey Platform (YASP)
services.description: Create surveys, manage questions, collect and analyze responses. User management with API keys. Embedded MCP at /mcp.

services.name: File Storage & CDN
services.description: S3-compatible object storage via MinIO. Buckets, upload/download, presigned URLs, Google Drive sync, semantic search, auto-indexing. Embedded MCP at /mcp.

services.name: City Map Posters
services.description: Minimalist city map poster generation from OpenStreetMap. Vector, raster, and district render modes, 17 themes, 300 DPI PNG output. Embedded MCP at /mcp.

services.name: Map Tile Cache
services.description: CartoDB tile caching proxy with look-ahead prefetching. 9 basemap styles for CB mapping apps. Embedded MCP at /mcp.

services.name: User Guide Generator
services.description: Automated documentation generation for CB apps. Playwright-based crawling, screenshot capture, markdown generation, state machine workflow. Embedded MCP at /mcp.

services.name: Geocoding Service
services.description: Geocoding via Nominatim with OpenStreetMap data. Forward geocoding, reverse geocoding, and OSM object lookup. Embedded MCP at /mcp.

services.name: SDR Scanner Control Plane
services.description: REST control plane for the SDR scanner stack on bali.lan. Band configuration, job orchestration, on-disk hit retrieval, post-capture analyses, named report bundles with HTML export.

services.name: Iterable API Wrapper
services.description: Multi-tenant Iterable API wrapper with local DuckDB sync. Manages email marketing projects, syncs contacts/campaigns/lists for fast local querying.

services.name: Airtable API Wrapper
services.description: Multi-tenant Airtable API wrapper with local DuckDB sync. Stores encrypted PATs, proxies CRUD, syncs bases/tables into DuckDB for fast SQL querying.

services.name: Document Ingestion Pipeline
services.description: Centralized document processing and data extraction. Accepts PDFs, images, Office docs, and text, returns structured data. Sync extraction, batch processing, async jobs.

services.name: SMS/MMS Gateway
services.description: Unified SMS/MMS gateway for Ejoin devices. Single send, bulk send, device management, webhook responses. Embedded MCP at /mcp.

services.name: WhatsApp Ingestion
services.description: WhatsApp message ingestion via Node.js relay. Message processing pipeline, AI gist generation. Embedded MCP at /mcp.

services.name: Webhook Router
services.description: Centralized webhook ingestion (Typeform, GitHub, Stripe). HMAC verification, async persistence, consumer-scoped access. Embedded MCP at /mcp.

services.name: Front Email Proxy
services.description: Front App email integration: inboxes, conversations, messages, drafts, contacts, tags, canned responses, teammates, comments, analytics exports. Embedded MCP at /mcp.

services.name: URL Shortener
services.description: Short links with privacy-preserving click analytics. Custom/auto slugs, expiry, user management with API keys, link ownership.

services.name: Headless Email Client
services.description: Headless email client API for IMAP/SMTP mailbox management. Session-based access, folder management, message CRUD, send/batch-send. Built for automation and AI agents. Embedded MCP at /mcp.

services.name: Infrastructure Manager
services.description: Infrastructure inventory, GitHub issues, project bootstrap, config management (nginx, systemd, DNS, certs), AI orchestration, deployment. Embedded MCP at /mcp.

services.name: Network Inventory
services.description: Network device inventory and topology. Fleet status, device inventory with snapshots, network topology visualization. Embedded MCP at /mcp.

services.name: TOR Cluster
services.description: Anonymous web fetching through Tor worker pool. Worker management, mode switching, endpoint discovery. Embedded MCP at /mcp.

services.name: Authentication Platform
services.description: OAuth 2.1 authorization server. PKCE, Dynamic Client Registration (RFC 7591), token revocation (RFC 7009). Group-based permissions, JWT with embedded permission claims, API key management, portal dashboard. Embedded MCP at /mcp.

services.name: System Monitor
services.description: Central monitoring, 14 agents, incident management with AI diagnosis, SMS alerts, self-healing remediation, agent reports. Embedded MCP at /mcp.

services.name: Log Query & Analysis
services.description: Read-only log querying and analysis across DC0 (impera). 8 log groups, syslog analysis (crash loops, OOM, segfaults), nginx access/error logs, CB service journals. Embedded MCP at /mcp.

services.name: MCP Service Catalog
services.description: MCP server exposing the CB service catalog to LLM agents. SSE transport for remote clients, Inspector UI for humans.

services.name: Scheduled Task Engine
services.description: Configurable scheduled task engine. Cron-based HTTP dispatch with retry logic, overlap protection, run history, and timezone support. Embedded MCP at /mcp.

services.name: Documentation Site
services.description: MkDocs Material documentation hub for the Campaign Brain platform. Architecture guides, service docs, API catalog, development guides, style guide.

services.name: API Mesh Gateway
services.description: WebSocket gateway for the API Mesh network. Service discovery, cluster health, request proxying across all registered CB services.

services.name: Claude Code Session Manager
services.description: Claude Code operating system: manage interactive Claude sessions, stash/apply context, JSON sessions for programmatic access, AI-powered task routing and prioritization. Embedded MCP at /mcp.

services.name: OpenWRT Router Manager
services.description: MCP/API frontend for OpenWRT router management. UCI config CRUD with rollback, network/firewall/wireless monitoring, package management, VPN rotation, file access. Embedded MCP at /mcp.

services.name: Network Fleet Manager
services.description: Fleet management for OpenWRT router/VPN/Tor network. Inventory, topology, fleet status, device snapshots. CLI and API for orchestrating upgrades, health probes, and traffic captures.

services.name: Auth Admin UI
services.description: Administration interface for cbauth. Manage users, API keys, PIN gates, and access control policies. Starlette-based web UI.

services.name: Tenant Manager
services.description: Multi-tenant deployment manager. Each tenant is a complete Campaign Brain deployment with its own domain, database, and configuration.

services.name: Campaign Management Platform
services.description: Core campaign management platform. Person/contact CRM, events, campaigns, surveys, walk lists, turf management, voter data, canvass forms, analytics dashboard.

services.name: Project Management
services.description: Project management and task tracking. Timeline views, kanban boards, resource allocation, milestones. Node.js/React application.

services.name: Rural AM/FM Rate Ingestion
services.description: Radio station political advertising rates for AI-powered media buying. 2,000+ stations, rate cards with OCR extraction, proposals, radio buys, order packets, FCC data, Nielsen ratings, coverage contours. Embedded MCP at /mcp.

services.name: Rural AM/FM Rate Ingestion (QA)
services.description: QA instance of cbradio. Mirrors production data for testing. Embedded MCP at /mcp.

services.name: Mobile Canvassing
services.description: Progressive Web App for door-knocking and canvassing. Offline-first with RxDB sync, DuckDB analytics, offline maps. iOS Safari optimized. Embedded MCP at /mcp.

services.name: Workflow Engine
services.description: CRM workflow automation. Contacts, templates, instances, connectors (SMS/email), multi-tenant, guides. Embedded MCP at /mcp.

services.name: Donation Processing
services.description: Campaign donation processing (Transaxt migration). Authorize.Net CIM, 4 portals. JWT auth, campaign/account history. Embedded MCP at /mcp.

services.name: Hospitality BI (VIP)
services.description: Virgin Islands Pulse: hospitality portfolio BI. Clover POS, Homebase, Cloudbeds, WebRezPro, QuickBooks. Finance, HR, guests, inbox. Embedded MCP at /mcp.

services.name: Issue Tracking
services.description: Unified GitHub issue management across CB repositories. Full CRUD, comments, project boards. Embedded MCP at /mcp.

services.name: Public Marketing Website
services.description: Campaign Brain public marketing website. Landing pages, feature overview, contact forms. Jinja2 templates served via FastAPI.

services.name: Test Bootstrap API
services.description: Test project for CBApp bootstrap template validation. Minimal API used to verify project scaffolding and deployment pipeline.

services.name: E-Signature Service
services.description: E-signature service backed by BoldSign. Send documents from templates, track signature status, manage signed document lifecycle.

services.name: Loom Workspace Builder
services.description: Campaign Brain workspace builder for composable data dashboards: content and narrative engine.

services.name: Banking Integration
services.description: Banking-partner SFTP/BAI2 pipeline. Pulls BAI2 prior-day reports from Huntington via OpenText hosted SFTP, parses and persists to DuckDB, exposes normalized export feeds for reconciliation.
